name: print-social-screen-time-infographic-mauve-flat
title: Mauve flat-illustration screen-time infographic
whatItIs: A vertical infographic on a dusty mauve background breaking down phone screen time by category (health, messengers, social, work, entertaining) with small illustrated panels, a pie chart and bar chart.
whatItMeans: Grouping stats into labeled illustrated 'windows' rather than one dense chart lets a reader skim by topic instead of parsing everything at once.
techniques: frame each data category in its own small illustrated panel/device screen
mix chart types (pie, bar) within one infographic to match each metric's shape
use one muted background color to let the varied panel colors stay legible without clashing

vocabulary.definition: a visual representation of data or information designed for quick comprehension
